# chronicle-fixture

Exercises T6's events/metrics/signals surface: log headings, a checkpoint
chain (one superseded), a goal with a valid and an invalid review date, a
noncanonical `±HHMM` timestamp, a concept page, and an archived page. No
`wiki/code/` or `src/` on purpose, to exercise the zero-candidate
`code.coverage_percent` -> unavailable path.
